title: Chronos: The AI Co-Historian
abstract: arXiv:2604.03553v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: AI is increasingly supporting, accelerating, and automating scientific discovery across subjects. Yet, the adoption of AI in historical research remains limited due to the lack of specialised solutions for historians. To change this, we introduce Chronos, an AI Co-Historian designed to support historians. It allows researchers to create and customize research workflows through natural-language interaction and share these as Chronos-Extensions with others. Chronos specifically addresses the need of historians for a tool that is specialised, non-technical, highly customizable, and facilitates extensive task evaluation. As a first extension, we introduce Chronos-Extract, which enables researchers to automate the targeted extraction of information from image scans of historical sources. translated_title: 编年史：AI 联合历史学家
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.03553v3 公告类型：替换 摘要：人工智能正日益支持、加速并自动化各学科的科学发现。然而，由于缺乏针对历史学家的专门解决方案，AI在历史研究中的应用仍然有限。为改变这一现状，我们引入了Chronos，一个旨在支持历史学家的AI联合历史学家。它允许研究人员通过自然语言交互创建和定制研究工作流，并可将这些工作流作为Chronos扩展与他人共享。Chronos特别满足了历史学家对工具的需求，这些工具需具备专业性、非技术性、高度可定制性，并便于进行广泛的任务评估。作为首个扩展，我们引入了Chronos-Extract，它使研究人员能够自动化地从历史资料的图像扫描中提取目标信息。我们在三个历史语料库上对Chronos-Extract进行了基准测试，发现它在跨越三个世纪的主要资料上实现了高任务准确性。
tldr: 本文介绍了Chronos，一个专为历史学家设计的AI联合历史学家，通过自然语言交互定制研究工作流，并推出首个扩展Chronos-Extract，实现从历史图像扫描中自动提取信息，在三个世纪的历史语料库上达到高准确性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Chronos, an AI co-historian tailored for historians, enabling natural-language customization of research workflows and debuts Chronos-Extract for automated information extraction from historical image scans, achieving high accuracy across three centuries of primary sources.
